scope: 299 selected pairs, 598 answers. Direct reading by this Codex assistant; no delegated model calls. Not expert clinical validation.
selection: Existing FPQ178 coding/Well disagreement pairs and NFP121 threshold-loss pairs. Not population error rates.
procedure: Read question, annotation, both full answers and original judge reasons; record exact quotes and a pair-level textual judgment. Early packets omitted scores/codes before comparison; later packets included judges in the same reading. All 299 selected pairs completed. No new model or judging calls.
blinding_limit: Not blinded: mixed score visibility, previous conversation, and cohort selection expose outcomes. Current assistant review is not human or independent expert adjudication.
selection_order: All Qwen2.5 selected records first, then same-item contrasts and sequential blocks until every selected pair was read.
taxonomy: Post-hoc manual harmonization of direct reading notes. One primary descriptive category per pair, secondary issues retained. Counts describe selected pairs, not causal prevalence or population error rates.
